titulo: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy
cuerpo: At Wednesday's iPhone Duo launch event, Apple announced a handful of new Siri AI Audio Intelligence features, including Siri Recap, Live Rewind, Sound Recognition, and Music Recognition.
